messages:
Alex H: FYI Magnetar RFI dropped into my inbox. They want a short POC runbook + traffic model and a one-paragraph ops summary. Deliverable EOD Thu. Who can own the runbook?

Priya S: I can own the runbook draft. Need bench numbers (qps/latency) and a note on KMS/HSM and audit logs. @Devin M can you paste a quick traffic model? Also we should spell out what we won't commit in POC (e.g., long-term HSM SLA).

Devin M: Pulled numbers from the perf harness last week. Rough figures for an 8k context model with 16 streams: sustained ~120 QPS/node, p95 ~320ms when batching tuned. For Magnetar profile (20 r/s steady, avg ~3k tokens):
```
baseline_nodes = 3
qps_per_node = 120
steady_qps = 20
burst_multiplier = 8
peak_qps = steady_qps * burst_multiplier  # 160
peak_p95_est = ~420ms
```
TL;DR: 3 nodes cover steady (<40% util), autoscale to 6-8 nodes for burst. I'll upload a CSV sample.

Samir K: Security check: their questionnaire expects customer-managed KMS and mentions HSM for at-rest keys. Can we support HSM in a hosted POC? @Charlie (sec-bot) please advise.

Charlie (sec-bot): Answer: we support customer-managed KMS in hosted clouds. HSM-backed keys (HSM CMKs) are supported only with Dedicated/Private deployments and need an SOW/contract addendum. Suggested RFI wording: "KMS (customer-managed) supported in hosted POC; HSM-backed CMKs available in Dedicated/Private after agreement." I'll attach the template.

Priya S: Good. For the runbook include: oncall contacts, escalation path, node-replacement steps, prefix cache flush, sticky routing to Dedicated pool for noisy neighbor, and model-fallback (quantized variant). Keep to 2 pages + appendix.

Devin M: Quick cost sketch (don't quote as final):
```
avg_tokens_per_req = 3000
steady_rps = 20
reqs_per_month = steady_rps * 3600 * 24 * 30
tokens_per_month = avg_tokens_per_req * reqs_per_month
est_cost_per_1M_tokens = $0.95  # hosted example
est_monthly = tokens_per_month / 1e6 * est_cost_per_1M_tokens
```
Note: if POC runs on Dedicated pricing will differ.

Alex H: Also include a short control-mapping table: control -> enforced-in (control plane / data plane / customer infra). Magnetar's compliance team will want that. Priya, add that to the appendix.

Priya S: Adding it. I'll also add a small section "POC scope & exclusions" listing things we won't commit (FedRAMP cert, long-term HSM SLA, 24/7 white-glove ops).

Devin M: Uploaded sample CSV: https://s3.redwood.ai/bench/magnetar_perf_sample.csv

Charlie (sec-bot): Sec template: https://drive.redwood.ai/sec/magnetar_kms_hsm_template.docx

Alex H: Plan: Priya runbook + appendix; Devin benchmark CSV + cost calc; Charlie security wording; I'll assemble slides + one-page RFI reply. Review meeting tomorrow 10:00am PT.

Priya S: Draft link: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/magnetar_runbook_v1 (private) - please comment by 6pm today.

Samir K: If they insist on HSM in hosted POC, we escalate to AE + Legal for an SOW.

Alex H: Thanks all. I'll post the compiled RFI for final signoff before EOD Thu. :thumbsup:
